owner_titles: The Reporting Person is Chief Executive Officer of Mach Natural Resources GP LLC, the general partner of the Issuer (the "General Partner"). The Issuer is managed by the directors and executive officers of the General Partner.
nature_of_ownership: Held by Tom L. Ward 1992 Revocable Living Trust
footnote_text: The Tom L. Ward 1992 Revocable Living Trust (the "Trust") purchased 172,413 common units in an unregistered block trade at a price of $11.60 per unit. || The Reporting Person is the Trustee of the Trust. By virtue of the relationship, the Reporting Person may be deemed to have or share beneficial ownership of the securities held of record by the Trust, but the Reporting Person disclaims any beneficial ownership of the reported securities other than to the extent of any pecuniary interest he may have therein, directly, or indirectly.
